description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the 'ModifyFeatures' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides nested interfaces for factories that generate command responses (such as created, modified, or error responses) and events (such as created or modified features).

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending a generic answer builder for handling responses and events for ModifyFeatures commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating various command response objects such as created, modified, or error responses.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects like FeaturesCreated and FeaturesModified.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for the ModifyFeatures command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for the ModifyFeatures command.

methods.name: featuresNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating features are not accessible.

methods.name: featuresNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating features are not modifiable.
